answer: Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 21 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Because the glacier solution is checked at the pearl gate and logged, the forge audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence burns the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The deposit is 8 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
